id.description: Unique identifier automatically generated for the Entity.

type.description: Entity Type defined by the selected domain.

beginning_of_process.description: Defines whether the Entity marks the beginning of the process.

end_of_process.description: Defines whether the Entity marks the end of the process.

status.description: Runtime status of the Entity, set by the Simulation Engine.

name.description: Human-readable name of the Flow Object.

generation_interval.description: Time interval between generated Flow Objects.

batch_size.description: Number of Flow Objects generated at each generation event.

target_lead_time.description: Target maximum time the Flow Object should spend in the system.

quality.description: Quality outcome of the Flow Object, set by the Simulation Engine.

process_requirements.description: Defines the required Process Supply quantities for each Processing Entity.

processing_entity_id.description: Processing Entity and its required Process Supply quantities.

process_supply_entity_id.description: Required quantity of the Process Supply.

id.description: Unique identifier automatically generated for the Relationship.

domains.name: Production
domains.description: The Production domain provides modelling guidance for production-oriented Entity Types / Roles and their relevant Properties, Relationships, and Rule Templates. These are modelling recommendations; they do not define hard-coded simulation behaviour.

processing_time.description: Time required to process one Flow Object.

capacity.description: Maximum number of Flow Objects processed at once.

changeover_time.description: Extra time added when switching to a different Flow Object type.

inspection_time.description: Time required to inspect one Flow Object.

capacity.description: Maximum number of Flow Objects inspected at once.
Maximum number of Flow Objects that can be stored.

initial_inventory.description: Initial quantity of Flow Objects in the Storage.

queue_rule.description: Rule determining the order in which Flow Objects leave the Storage.

transport_time.description: Time required to transport one Flow Object.

capacity.description: Maximum number of Flow Objects that can be transported at once.
Maximum quantity of supplied material available.

replenishment_quantity.description: Quantity added at each replenishment event.

base_failure_probability.description: "Fresh" (just maintained or repaired) per-cycle probability that the Entity fails.

added_failure_probability_per_cycle.description: Additional failure probability accrued for each cycle since the last maintenance or repair.

mean_repair_time.description: Average time required to repair the Entity after an unplanned failure.

maintenance_interval.description: Number of cycles since the last maintenance or repair after which the Entity proactively enters planned maintenance.

base_scrap_probability.description: "Fresh" (just maintained or repaired) per-cycle probability that a Flow Object becomes scrap from ordinary process variation, independent of any Entity failure.

added_scrap_probability_per_cycle.description: Additional scrap probability accrued for each cycle since the last maintenance or repair.

capacity.description: Maximum number of simultaneous maintenance/repair operations across the whole model.

dispatch_priority.description: Order in which waiting maintenance/repair requests are dispatched when the shared capacity is exhausted (top = highest priority).
